iwr: iwr — to conceive, become pregnant (verb); iwr·i 'I was conceived'

iꜣkb: iꜣkb — to mourn, wail (verb); iꜣkbyt 'wailing woman, mourner' (noun f.)
iḏb: iḏb — bank, riverbank, shore (noun m.); dual iḏbwy 'the Two Banks' (Egypt, or the Nile's two sides)
rḫtt: rḫtt — a place name, not identified (Budge: Reχtet; meaning uncertain)
tštš: tštš — a name of Osiris, not explained (Budge: Teśteś; meaning uncertain)
tpḥt: tpḥt — cavern, hollow, hole in the earth (noun f.; plural tpḥwt)
iꜥi: iꜥi — to wash, bathe (verb); iꜥw 'washing' (noun of action)
wrd: wrd — to be weary, tired (verb); wrd-ib 'Weary of heart', a name of the dead Osiris (Budge: urṭ; reading doubtful here)

qꜥḥ: qꜥḥ — shoulder, perhaps arm (noun; Budge: qāḥ; exact sense uncertain)
dr: dr — to drive away, repel, subdue (verb)
ꜥbt: ꜥbt — offering, offerings (noun f.; Budge: ābet; reading doubtful)
snwt: snwt — the sixth-day feast, held on the sixth day of the lunar month (noun f.; written with six strokes, which Budge reads as the numeral 'six')
dnit: dnit — the Denit feast, a feast of the lunar month (noun f.; Budge: Ṭenàt)
rrw: rrw — a name or word not understood; perhaps a title or place in Busiris (Budge: Rere, with a query; meaning uncertain)
ḥbt: ḥbt — ritual book, the book of festival rites (noun f.; from ḥb 'festival')

stkn: stkn — to bring near, usher in, introduce (verb; causative of tkn 'approach')
mnḫ: mnḫ — effective, excellent, beneficent (adjective; plural mnḫw)
ḥms: ḥms — to sit, be seated, dwell (verb; reading of the sign doubtful in this part)
mṯn: mṯn — road, path (noun m.; plural mṯnw; Budge: mātennu; reading doubtful)
dnd: dnd — a word of unclear sense, perhaps 'rage, wrath' (noun; Budge: ṭenṭ, 'confidence'; meaning uncertain)
sšw: sšw — to empty, make empty (verb; causative of šwi 'be empty'; Budge: sesu-θà; reading doubtful)
